title: Easy Grilled Filipino Chicken Skewers
description: A quick and easy Filipino dish featuring marinated chicken skewers grilled to perfection, served in an earthenware bowl. This low-carb friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, lime juice, garlic, ginger, brown sugar, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the chicken pieces to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the chicken to marinate.
Preheat the yakimono grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the chicken skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve the grilled chicken skewers in an earthenware bowl and garnish with sliced green onions and a sprinkle of black pepper.
